ideas.pitch: A real-time biomedical monitoring app that uses ElevenLabs voice synthesis and speech analysis to detect post-operative patient complications through vocal fatigue and tremor patterns.
ideas.title: VoiceVitals: ElevenLabs-Powered Post-Op Voice Biomarker Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the ElevenLabs sponsor prize track by using their audio APIs for a serious healthcare application, leveraging the hard-engineering edge seen in winning biomedical and IoT projects.

ideas.pitch: An edge-AI computer vision pipeline running locally to detect hardhat and PPE violations in factory floors without cloud dependency.
ideas.title: EdgeGuard: Offline NPU Industrial Safety Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the proven success of offline edge-AI and industrial safety detection systems while fitting the Best Software and AI Credits tracks through high-performance local inference.

ideas.pitch: A desktop-sized robotic sorting arm driven by a computer vision model that classifies and separates recyclable waste into correct bins live.
ideas.title: EcoSort: Autonomous Smart Waste Segregator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses an unusual physical build with a live working demo, replicating the exact formula that wins hardware tracks at robotics and IoT-focused hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A compact mobile robot equipped with obstacle avoidance and SLAM mapping to guide visitors through college building corridors autonomously.
ideas.title: CampusNav: JetBot Autonomous Indoor Guidance Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex robotics perception navigation stacks that consistently sweep hardware and grand prizes by showcasing difficult physical systems working in real-time.

ideas.pitch: A voice-activated control panel allowing engineers to speak natural commands to diagnose and query college lab IoT sensor anomalies via an agentic LLM pipeline.
ideas.title: VoiceOps: Conversational Multi-Agent IoT Diagnostic Console
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines ElevenLabs voice inputs with an agentic backend, aligning with sponsor tech while delivering an exceptionally polished UI for the Best Design track.
